answer_1.quote: We introduce a corruption-based augmentation strategy for essays (CASE), which starts with a well-written essay and incorporates a certain portion of sentence-level errors into the synthetic essay.

answer_2.quote: We measure a quadratic weighted kappa (QWK) score to measure the similarity between the gold label of the synthetic sample and the predicted score by an AES model.

answer_3.quote: We test gpt-4o with four different system prompts as follows: ... Asking gpt-4o to score an essay shows high variances among the essays with the same score, implying their limitations to be applied as AES systems.

answer_4.quote: We collect scoring data from 11 instructors, who serve as the teachers of the students who wrote the essays. ... All annotators are experts in English education or Linguistics and are qualified to teach EFL writing courses at a college in South Korea.
answer_4.guideline: The essays are scored on a range of 1 to 5, with increments of 0.5, based on the three rubrics: content, organization, and language.
